IRIS says ITG07 most closely aligns with Chafer/APT39, which Symantec describes as an alleged Iran-based group. The report describes a custom backdoor, TREKX, first reported by NCCGroup in March 2019, and tools including custom mimikatz, NBTScan, PsExec and webshells. f1c6d01a3f24b249a9a01b53f751a2b729aadd4c.summary: Intezer reports on Linux.GreedyAntd, a cryptojacking malware family on compromised Linux servers, classified under a group it calls Pacha Group. The first-stage dropper kills rival miners, disguises its process, persists via a systemd service, and coordinates secondary stagers over a named pipe. The deployed miner is an XMRig variant that uses the Stratum protocol through proxies. The report believes the authors are of Chinese origin and suggests a possible link to Linux.HelloBot through shared static libc code, hedged as potential. Report dated February 28, 2019.
